QuestInfo.name: 2012 Artifact Hunt Contest Participation
QuestInfo.0: You can receive a Participation Prize for reaching 5000 points in the Artifact Hunt Contest.
QuestInfo.1: You can receive a Participation Prize for reaching 5000 points in the Artifact Hunt Contest.
QuestInfo.2: Reaching 5000 points in the Artifact Hunt Contest earned you a medal and a Weapon Attack, Magic Attack, and Speed buff. If you push yourself harder, you might be able to reach the top 10 and get a special gift.
